domain_coverage_contract.purpose: broad repeated-manoeuvre MH370 inference from M1822 through M0011
domain_coverage_contract.latitude: complete WGS-84 [-90, 90] support at 0.5 degree spacing
domain_coverage_contract.longitude: complete WGS-84 [-180, 180) query support; +180 exactly duplicates the -180 physical meridian
domain_coverage_contract.boundary_semantics: an out-of-domain state is a data-coverage failure, not evidence against its control history
domain_coverage_contract.quantitative_reach_proof: recorded in the matching canonical MH370 ERA5 manifest

limitations: IGRF represents the large-scale core field, not local crustal anomalies.
One reference epoch is used for the 6.15-hour inference; secular variation over that interval is negligible.
Magnetic declination is direction-valued and undefined exactly at magnetic-field singularities; the runtime interpolates it circularly to avoid false jumps at +/-180 degrees.
At the exact geographic poles, east and north are coordinate-singular even though the stored IGRF values are finite.
The two exact geographic-pole rows store the finite one-sided declination limit synthesized at +/-89.999999 degrees to avoid roundoff NaNs in the official geodetic conversion helper.
